title: Tiny Visitor
description: A damselfly (Zygoptera) rests in the hole of a leaf in Romania. These insects are similar to dragonflies but have slimmer bodies and narrower wings. Damselflies have long fascinated photographer Remus Tiplea, who became deeply familiar with their behaviors after spending years photographing them.
translated_description: 一只豆娘（束翅亚目）在罗马尼亚一片叶子的孔洞中休憩。这类昆虫与蜻蜓相似，但身体更纤细，翅膀更窄长。摄影师雷穆斯·蒂普利亚长期痴迷于豆娘，经过多年拍摄，他对它们的习性已了如指掌。
